summary: Backend smoke tested via public URL with seeded session. Auth, profile CRUD, programs CRUD, questions/generate, analyze/speech, progress/summary, and Stripe checkout+status all pass. Four LLM-powered endpoints (analyze/sarr, interview/start, programs/know, programs/why-us) return 500 due to EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget exceeded (max $0.001, current $0.022 per litellm error). Because interview/start failed, /interview/message and /interview/end/{sid} could not be exercised.
passed: GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token returns user JSON (user_id, email, name)
PUT /api/profile persists fields present in ProfileUpdate schema; returns user_id + updated_at
POST /api/programs creates and returns program_id + user_id
POST /api/questions/generate returns questions array with q/category/why_asked (LLM call succeeded)
POST /api/analyze/speech returns overall_score (28), wpm (84), filler_count (5) plus tips (LLM call succeeded)
GET /api/progress/summary returns categories(7 keys), overall_readiness, streak_days, weakest
POST /api/payments/checkout returns checkout_url + session_id using lookup_key matchprep_pro_monthly

failed.issue: POST /api/analyze/sarr, /api/interview/start, /api/programs/know, /api/programs/why-us all return 500 Internal Server Error
failed.evidence: backend.err.log: litellm.RateLimitError: 'Budget has been exceeded! Key=dahkvt0tsumc73anqttg Current cost: 0.022098, Max budget: 0.001'. Fields sent by client are valid; failure originates from emergentintegrations chat.send_message.

failed.issue: Could not verify POST /api/interview/message and POST /api/interview/end/{session_id} because /interview/start returns 500 (same LLM budget cause).
failed.evidence: Dependency chain: no session_id available to call message/end.

failed.issue: Request fields cv_text, strengths, weaknesses in the review request are silently dropped (not part of ProfileUpdate model). Not a 500, but worth confirming whether product expects these to persist.
failed.evidence: Response omitted those keys; only schema fields returned.

action_items: Increase / refresh EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget (currently capped at $0.001 which is exhausted after a couple LLM calls). Without this, SARR, interview, program-know, why-us cannot function.
After budget fix, retest: POST /api/analyze/sarr, /api/interview/start -> /message -> /end/{sid}, /api/programs/know, /api/programs/why-us for structured JSON fields.
Optional: confirm whether ProfileUpdate should include cv_text/strengths/weaknesses (product spec mentions CV-based profile).
test_credentials: Was empty; seeded a user + session and recorded token in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
